proposed_facts.reason: Unlink explicitly repairs predecessor next as well as the head case; null and absent inputs preserve state.
Exact-mask waits, borrowed context, deepest-first drawing, nonzero-result bypass and terminal panic match the thread.
Initializer and input traversal support the source-state explanation; compiled BSS placement is explicitly excluded.
Initializer explicitly assigns x8 to framebuffer height after clearing the singleton.
FPSAVED guard, FPR accesses, 0x24-word PSF offsets and temporary-context restoration match canonical code.
Context-report caller invokes this reporter; PSF heading alone cannot establish separate saved-register storage.
Signature and read-only use of supplied context are supported; temporary context is separate.
Both 32-row loops and the offset-based float reinterpretation are explicit.
Main, memory and address menu descriptors share the renderer; main navigation targets report coordinates.
Initially negative col skips initialization of ch; absolute-column drawing and style restoration are explicit.
Each of eight iterations permits one zero retry; result is passed to the address editor before the viewer.
Editor/menu push paths return true, and the thread bypasses dirty restart for that result.
Command masks, prefix removal, capture restoration and literal GQR/PSF sourcing match the helpers and dispatcher.
Diagnostic mapping is retained without claiming correctly sourced complete processor state.
Dispatch responsibilities are accurate and register-report completeness is appropriately qualified.
Modulo initialization does not establish alignment or whole-row read safety.
Exact initializer expression is reproduced, including its nonzero-memory-size assumption.
Nested 4-by-4-by-4 byte loops emit 64 bytes; raw pointer, forced capture-off and actual node targets are preserved.
Memory input opens the address editor and memory action menu, not CPU-context or SPR nodes.
Recognized command branches return 1; dump length and screen transitions match source.
Initializer only masks and prefixes the address; RAM-bound comparison occurs on acceptance.
Literal address format and buf[19+index] differ from the edited nibble positions; trailing space can be highlighted.
Style lifecycle, rasterizer selection, normal index bounds and nibble shifts are explicit.
Fixed read bank, permission &2, invariant G, block bits and address masks match canonical expressions.
BAT diagnostic mapping fits while fixed-bank and lossy-presentation caveats prevent architectural overstatement.
Four pairs, two rows each and selector-dependent heading are supported; existing BAT-page name remains appropriate.
Style restoration and exceptional permission/G branches match source.
Console-thread caller and explicit particle-misnomer comment support the more accurate DebugConsole prefix.
Unsigned addition wraps for 0xFFFFFFF1 through 0xFFFFFFFF before shifting; downstream meaning remains unspecified.
Foreign history/XFB services, local borrowed-context rendering and separate overlay definitions establish the corrected ownership scope.

contradictions.reason: Accept predecessor-mutation correction; retain the supported single-node unlink role.
Accept all three restart-related fact corrections: nonzero input results jump past the dirty check, including report command paths returning true.
Accept initialization correction: cleared state does not imply zero final pixel y.
Accept all PSF and complete-register-report corrections. Literal offsets, not headings or rendered names, govern storage interpretation; supported diagnostic roles and signatures remain retained.
Accept shared-menu mapping correction: main commands navigate report text, while memory/address menus reuse the renderer.
Accept exceptional negative-column caveat and parser read-count/editor-handoff correction.
Accept both normalization-safety corrections and mask-only editor correction: starting-address selection does not prove all subsequent reads safe.
Accept all memory-dump size and destination corrections: capture emits 64 raw sequential bytes; targets are the editor and memory action menu.
Accept both address-highlight corrections: highlighted character and edited nibble are offset in the literal format.
Accept all BAT corrections while retaining the supported BAT-page name. Heading selection does not change the read bank; R/O is unreachable and G invariant.
Accept the meaningful input-renewal rename rather than preserving the documented particle misnomer.
Accept unsigned-size wrap correction; no downstream allocation meaning is inferred.
Accept history-ownership correction and both stale overlay-link rejections. Report history is accessed through hsd_393C; overlay constructor and descriptors are defined in hsd_3982.

Accept deferral of all four compiled-section facts and four section-associated links. Source supports scalar/state/stack and metadata roles, but not exact compiled membership, sizes, ordering, relocations or addresses. Supported source-level knowledge remains retained.

unresolved: Exact compiled section layout and section-associated links remain deferred pending validated compiled evidence.

Borrowed-context lifetime, stack-local OSThread lifetime, shared-stack reentry and the reported stack-end boundary concern remain cross-file follow-up work; acceptance does not establish runtime safety.
Historical parameter identities and renderer parse/shadowed-binding issues remain inherited uncertainties; no identity changes are proposed.

Acceptance covers all 30 proposed changes and the examined upstream contradictions, not a new independent audit of every inherited retained fact or link. Supported unchanged research rows are inherited without rewriting.
